svg.title: Career trajectory: flight path
svg.desc: A comet climbs a rising helix through dated waypoints; front strands glow, back strands fade. 2015 Anna University, BE Mechanical Engineering. 2016 to 2017 CVS Health, pharmacy apps, led API development. 2017 to 2018 Woolworths in Sydney, retail, ASP.NET and C# N-tier. 2018 to 2019 McKesson, pharma SaaS, Flask and C# Web API. 2019 to 2022 Humana, specialty pharmacy, led the backend team. 2022 to 2023 Agero, serverless data sync, FastAPI on AWS Lambda. 2023 to 2025 Freddie Mac, ML forecasting, led the backend team. 2025 to 2026 Capital One, finance, a 50+ AWS microservice platform. Now: Freddie Mac, ML forecasting, FastAPI on EKS/ECS.
svg.text: A rising helix: ten years, five domains.
